Report of a male Chinese suffering from stab
wound alleged to have been received on Ichang Rd.

At 10.05 a.m. 25.3.41, a telephone message was
received at the Station via street telephone box No. 1,
from C.P.C. 2605 reporting that a male Chinese had received
a bayonet wound of the back whilst walking on Ichang Road.

D.S. Mori, C.D.B. 105 and the undersigned attended
and a male Chinese who was sitting on the kerb at the
corner of Ferry and Ichang Roads was pointed out by the
C.P.C. as the victim.

The injured man was immediately removed to the
Shou Ming Hospital, where after receiving treatment,
the following Dr's chit was issued. "Stab wound of the
back near waist region, not detained."

When questioned at the Station, the injured man,
who appeared to be mentally deranged, gave his particulars
as following:

Yang To Ching (楊志敬), 40, Singl.
H/unemployed, residing street nil, U.O.I.

He stated that at about 9.45 a.m. 25.3.41 he
was sitting on the kerb on Ichang Road opposite the S.W.E.
No. 3 and 4 mills, when he was approached by a Japanese
sentry who ordered him to move. As he did not move very
quickly, the Japanese pulled his bayonet from his sheath
and prodded him in the back causing a wound. The injured
man then walked West along Ichang Road and reported the

关于一名中国男子在宜昌路 alleged（据称）被刺伤的_report（报告）。

41年3月25日上午10:05，巡捕房通过1号街头电话亭接到来自中央巡捕房（C.P.C.）2605号的电话消息，报告称一名中国男子在宜昌路行走时背部被刺刀刺伤。

警佐森（Mori），华探第105号及本人前往现场，中央巡捕房人员指认坐在渡轮路与宜昌路转角路缘石上的一名中国男子为受害者。

伤者立即被送往守明医院，经治疗后，医生出具了如下便条：“腰部附近背部刺伤，不予留院。”

在巡捕房受询时，这名看似精神错乱的伤者提供了以下个人资料：

杨志敬（Yang To Ching），40岁，单身。
职业：无业，住址：无，籍贯：江苏（U.O.I.）。

    Enquiries by J.I. Shimizu and D.S. Mori at the N.W.K.
mill resulted in an interview with Petty Officer Inouye.
He stated that the man had been noticed sitting on the
kerb acting in a demented fashion. Suddenly the man
started waving his arms and attracting the attention of
various pedestrians, therefore the sentry walked across
the road and ordered the man to move. This order was
obeyed and the man walked West towards Ferry Road.
However before reaching the corner, he stopped in the
middle of the roadway and started to cry out. A large
crowd of pedestrians gathered around and as a result,
the roadway was blocked.
    At this time, a U.S.M.C. motor truck came along and
was forced to stop owing to the crowd, therefore several
marines descended from the truck and walked forward to
where the man was standing.
    A few seconds later, the marines returned to the
truck and drove away.
    After the motor truck left the scene, the man again
returned to the mill and as he continued to make a noise,
the Japanese sentry again ordered him away and then walked
behind him until he reached Ferry Road.
    Lieut. Stewart, U.S.M.C. was informed of the occurrence

在6号岗执勤的中央巡捕房人员报告了此事。附陈述书。
    清水（Shimizu）警探和森（Mori）警佐在西北纱厂（N.W.K. mill）进行调查，结果与井上（Inouye）少尉进行了面谈。井上少尉称，注意到该男子坐在路缘石上，行为举止疯癫。突然，该男子开始挥舞手臂，引起多名行人的注意，因此哨兵穿过马路命令该男子离开。该男子服从了命令，并向西朝渡轮路方向走去。然而，在到达拐角之前，他在路中间停下并开始大喊大叫。大量行人围观，导致道路堵塞。
    此时，一辆美国海军陆战队（U.S.M.C.）的卡车驶来，因人群阻挡被迫停车，因此几名海军陆战队员下车，走向该男子站立的地方。
    几秒钟后，海军陆战队员返回卡车并驾车离开。
    卡车离开现场后，该男子再次回到纱厂，由于他继续制造噪音，日本哨兵再次命令他离开，并跟在他身后直到他到达渡轮路。
    美国海军陆战队斯图尔特（Stewart）中尉获悉此事

Yang Ts Ching.

C.D.C. 124.
Pootoo Rd Stn.    25.3.41.    translated    Clerk Chin Kung Kong.

My name is Yang Ts Ching. I am 40 years old, married
and a native of Chili (Hopei). I reside in a straw hut on
Connaught Road near Yamping Road.

About three weeks ago, I was employed as a highway
coolie at the R.A.D. Markham Road Depot. Owing to insufficient
work, I was dismissed. From that time, I suffered from heart
trouble.

At about 7 a.m. 25.3.41, I left my home and proceeded
to seek work. When arriving at Ferry Road near the Creek,
I was very tired. I then sat on the pavement by the road.
Suddenly a Japanese sentry approached and drove me. He
stabbed me on the back with his bayonet.

Later a policeman arrived at the scene and brought me
to the Station.

This is my true statement.

Signed. Yang Ts Ching.

华探第124号。
浦东路巡捕房    41年3月25日。    翻译    职员陈公孔（Chin Kung Kong）。

我叫杨志敬。今年40岁，已婚，籍贯直隶（河北）。我住在康纳特路（Connaught Road）靠近延平路（Yamping Road）的一间草棚里。

大约三周前，我在雷米洋行（R.A.D.）马克姆路（Markham Road）堆栈担任搬运夫。由于工作量不足，我被解雇。从那时起，我就患上了心脏病。

41年3月25日上午7点左右，我离家外出找工作。当到达靠近浜边的渡轮路时，我感到非常疲惫。于是我坐在路边的便道上。突然，一名日本哨兵走近并驱赶我。他用刺刀刺了我的背部。

后来一名警察到达现场并将我带到巡捕房。

这是我的真实陈述。

签名：杨志敬。

                                               ------- Clerk Chin Thang Kong.

Sir,

      At about 9 a.m. 25.3.41, whilst on post duty on Ichang
Road near Ferry Road, I saw a male Chinese coming west along
the road. He was followed by a Japanese sentry, who appeared
to drive him. When the man approached me, he reported that
he had been stabbed twice. On examination of his body, I
found one stab wound. I then reported the occurrence to the
station through street telephone.

      A party of police attended and conveyed the injured man
to Shou Ming Hospital for treatment.

      I did not see the Japanese sentry's bayonet.

      With the exception of the Japanese marines stationed
at the H...K. Hill, I did not see any foreign military in the
vicinity.

先生，

      41年3月25日上午9点左右，当我在靠近渡轮路的宜昌路岗哨执勤时，我看到一名中国男子沿路向西走来。他身后跟着一名日本哨兵，似乎在驱赶他。当该男子走近我时，他报告说被刺了两刀。检查其身体后，我发现一处刺伤。随后我通过街头电话向巡捕房报告了此事。

一名中国男子被日本海军陆战队从虹口浜带走。

41年3月15日晚上9:50，接到日本海军陆战队（N.L. Party）的电话消息，称一名中国男子试图跳入虹口浜自杀。

本人、警司石桥（Ishibashi）和华探第134号前往现场，一名
梁成（Liang Zung），27岁，单身/无业，广东籍，
非上海居民（N.F.A.），
由百老汇桥上的哨兵移交。

此人移交时全身赤裸，双手被绳索反绑在背后。他因寒冷而受苦，且发现头部后侧有伤。

梁成被送往莱斯脱医院（Lester Hospital）接受治疗，未被留院。未出具医生便条。

对他进行了讯问，但直到41年3月16日凌晨12:30，他仍无法提供关于如何在浜中被发现的任何信息。

41年3月16日凌晨12:30，从他那里查明了以下情况。

他与兄弟梁洪（Liang Oong），29岁，单身/无业，广东籍，非上海居民（N.F.A.），在过去一周内一直居住在元芳路170号“同发”客栈（"Toong Fah" Lodging House）

Yuen-fong Road.
    Liang Jung, during this period, has been suffering
from the effect of blows received on the Hongkew Wharf
during a fight, and quarrels have ensued in the lodging
house over him refusing to arise by the hour stipulated
by the lodging house staff.
    At about 9.30 p.m. 15-3-41, a quarrel commenced
between Liang Jung and friends of a tea boy, during
which Liang Jung ran away, being followed by the others,
and reaching the Hongkew Creek, jumped in to escape them,
the creek at this time being mostly mud, the tide being
out.
    The others, seeing him jump into the creek, attempted
to pull him out with a hooked bamboo pole, and having
grappled him, he, again to evade them, stripped off his
clothes.
    At this time, the Japanese sentries arrived and took
him from the creek, they tying him with rope.
    Detectives visited the lodging house, and located
the brother, Liang Oong, in bed. He stated that his
brother, for the past week, has been light-headed owing
to injuries received during the fight on the Hongkew
Wharf, which would probably account for him jumping into
the creek, and then stripping himself of his clothes.
    None of those concerned in the quarrel leading up

元芳路。
    在此期间，梁成因之前在虹口码头打架时受到的殴打影响，一直身体不适，且因拒绝按客栈规定的时间起床，在客栈内引发了争吵。
    41年3月15日晚上9:30左右，梁成与一名茶房的朋辈发生争吵，期间梁成逃跑，其他人紧随其后，他跑到虹口浜边，为躲避他们而跳入浜中，当时正值退潮，浜中多为淤泥。
    其他人见他跳入浜中，试图用带钩的竹竿将他拉出，在抓住他后，他为再次躲避他们，脱掉了衣服。
    此时，日本哨兵赶到，将他从浜中带走，并用绳子捆绑。
    侦探们走访了客栈，在床上找到了其兄弟梁洪。梁洪称，他的兄弟在过去一周因在虹口码头打架受伤而头脑不清，这大概解释了他为何跳入浜中并脱光衣服。

Arrest of a male Chinese mentally deficient for

逮捕一名智力低下之中国男子，因其试图处置据称为伪造的小贩执照。

41年3月10日上午8:30，中央巡捕房1140号和2738号将一名名为杨柏青（Yang Poh Ching）的中国男子带至巡捕房，该男子24岁，常州人，职业：苦力，住杰斯菲尔德路（Jessfield Road）旁新康里（Sing Kong Li）。他们于41年3月10日上午8:15在罗宾逊路（Robison Road）南荣华里（South Iung Hwa Li）将其逮捕，当时他正试图在弄堂内向小贩出售据称为执照的文件。

他持有一大批盖有蓝色印章“姚忠义”（Yau Tsoong Zee）的文件，地址为大通路151号。（该地址是姚先生，华探（Chinese）的地址，但名字的字样不同）。

经周克斯（Weeks）侦探长和华探第134号讯问，被捕男子称，这些文件是41年3月10日上午6:30在曹家渡四海利（Tsih Hai Lee）茶馆遇到的一位姓张（Tsang）的人给他的，那人还给了他2.00美元，并告诉他可以将这些文件以20或30美分的价格卖给无照小贩，鉴于他目前失业，他可以保留收取的钱款。

effect that at about 11 a.m. 14-12-40 one named Tsan Jia
Yu (湯加榮), residing at 1009 Haining Road, together with
three male Chinese and two, believed to be Japanese, visit-
ed his shop, but suddenly left without first expressing
the reason for their visit.

Acting by the complt. the investigating detectives
located the wanted person at the above address. Upon
being questioned, he stated that he is engaged in export-
ing Chinese story books and is also a member of the
"Chinese Story Books Exporters Union". The complt. on
the morning of 14-12-40 convened a meeting at his shop
with a view to standardising export prices of their products.
It was during this period that two of his Japanese friends
called at complt's shop, having been directed there by
his wife when they paid a visit to his home. He steadfast-
ly denied having any ulterior motive as was construed by
the complt. on seeing Japanese approaching his premises.

先生，

1940年12月14日上午11时45分，海宁路1050号三楼 Chin Yi (S) B) 书店店主王守伦（Wang Shou Lun）来到警局报案，称约于1940年12月14日上午11时，居住在海宁路1009号的汤加荣（Tsan Jia Yu）偕同三名华籍男子及两名据信为日本人的男子访问了他的书店，但未说明来访原因便突然离开。

根据报案人的指引，调查侦探在上述地址找到了被查询人。经讯问，该人称其从事中国故事书出口业务，也是“中国故事书出口商公会”的成员。报案人于1940年12月14日上午在其店内召开会议，旨在统一其产品的出口价格。在此期间，他的两位日本朋友来访，是因其妻在他们拜访其住所时指引他们前往报案人的书店。他坚决否认有任何如报案人见日本人接近其处所时所揣测的不良动机。
